scope: Built-in generation with exact owned cached Apache-2.0 data and headers false; existing-table init; static version updates; nonsensitive config set. No target network, uv, environment creation, generated-code/workflow execution or publishing.
oracles: Declare complete intended TOML values and relevant exact generated/preserved bytes and directory entries before launch. Independently reject incorrect captures. Same-execution public state assertions, exact exit, positive readiness/completion, reviewed snapshots and confirmed process/workspace cleanup. No source faults selected until complete canonical inputs are frozen.
